description.value: The WISE Hall is a storied East Vancouver institution founded in 1957 as a social club for Welsh, Irish, Scottish, and English immigrants, now a 250-capacity concert venue with a rich history of Canadian performers gracing its stage. The downstairs Lounge is a classic cash-only neighborhood pub with pool table and darts, operating as a members-and-guests club open to anyone 19+ with valid ID. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a genuinely local hangout steeped in community history, steps from the Adanac cycling corridor.

raw_osm.description: Long-running performing arts & concert venue with a downstairs tavern featuring billiards & Wi-Fi.
raw_osm.name: Wise Club & Hall

No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, refill — are explicitly mentioned on the website; the OSM description text references Wi-Fi but the lounge page does not corroborate it, so it remains null per the rules.
